tasks.instruction: Return whether bit number p1 of p0 is set, where bit 0 is the least significant bit.
tasks.note: Shift distance uses the low five bits, so bit 32 means bit 0.

tasks.instruction: This returns whether p0 is a power of two, but it wrongly says true for zero. Make it return false for zero.
tasks.note: Zero passes the x&(x-1) check; one is 2^0 and must stay true.

tasks.instruction: f should return whether p1 appears anywhere in the array p0. Fix it so every element is examined.
tasks.note: Start skips the last element; index 4 would wrap to 0.

tasks.instruction: Return true when the low 8 bits of p0 contain an odd number of set bits; higher bits must be ignored.
tasks.note: Bits 0..7 inclusive; 256 checks the upper bound.

tasks.instruction: f should rotate p0 left by p1 bits (bits shifted out at the top come back in at the bottom). Fix the rotation.
tasks.note: Rotation by 0 must keep the value; shift distances use the low five bits.

tasks.instruction: f currently computes p0 times 3 divided by 4. Change it to compute p0 times 5 divided by 8 (the multiply wraps modulo 2^32, the division rounds down).
Round p0 up to the nearest multiple of p1; a value that is already a multiple must stay unchanged.
tasks.note: p1 = 0 gives a division by zero (all ones) times 0 = 0.

tasks.instruction: f extracts an 8-bit field of p0 starting at bit p1. Make the field width p2 bits instead of always 8 (p2 is between 0 and 31).
f sums the array. Change it so that the element at position i is multiplied by i+1 before it is added (sums wrap modulo 2^32).
tasks.note: Tests call f; the edit is in the fold step ws.

tasks.instruction: f should apply mix twice: first to p0 with key p1, then to that result with key p1 shifted right by 16 bits.
tasks.note: Expected values computed with wrapping multiply by 16777619.

tasks.instruction: f should convert p0 to its reflected binary Gray code, p0 xor (p0 shifted right by one).
Return the midpoint of p0 and p1 rounded down, assuming p0 <= p1, without the sum overflowing.
Return p0 rotated left by p1 positions: element j of the result is element j+p1 of p0, wrapping around the end.
f overwrites element p1 of p0 with p2. Change it so the element only changes when p2 is larger: it becomes the larger of its old value and p2.
Return the quotient and remainder of p0 divided by p1, except that when p1 is zero the result must be (0, p0).
tasks.note: Record results are written as JSON arrays of their fields.

tasks.instruction: Return the wrapped sum of p0 and p1 together with a flag that is true exactly when the addition carried out of 32 bits.
tasks.note: Carry iff the wrapped sum is below p0.
